item.description:
Kipowi 0.8.1

  • Marking a part of a sound no longer leaves a band behind each time. A level region that is still at zero is just the mark; pull it to a level and it stays, because then it changes what gets written.
  • A selection and a level edit no longer look the same. The stretch you are working on is a full-height frame; a level region is a band whose height is the change itself — nothing at zero, a tall block at +12 dB.
  • Undo now reaches the sound. Marking a stretch and setting a level could not be undone at all before. Levels, marks and cuts share one undo, so ⌘Z takes back whatever you did last.
